claim_verdicts.evidence: alerts.md L27-28 (stage-4): "Burn rate là phần request xấu chia cho phần SLO cho phép xấu (1 − SLO). Burn rate 1 tiêu hết error budget đúng vào cuối cửa sổ của SLO." Concept is defined by the project document; no Prometheus behaviour involved.

Round 2: slo.md L24-27 names S1 "Đặt đơn không lỗi", S2 "Đặt đơn đủ nhanh", S3 "Đọc sản phẩm không lỗi", S4 "Yêu cầu hoàn tiền trong 2 giây" (bad = slower than le="2.048"); L60 "28 ngày trượt"; L64-67 99,5/99/99,5/99%. Read from the submodule working tree (git show blocked this session); lines 58-67 match the stage-4 block quoted in the lesson, verified in round 1.

Arithmetic checked: 28 × 24 = 672 (alerts.md L30 "28 ngày, tức 672 giờ"); 28/2 = 14; 28/6 = 4.67; 28/3 = 9.33; 28/8 = 3.5; 28/16 = 1.75; one hour at rate b = b × (1/672) of the budget given b = bad/allowed and uniform traffic (caveat stated in claim 10).

Arithmetic checked against slo.md L64-67 allowances: 3%/0.5% = 6; 3%/1% = 3; 1%/0.5% = 2; 1%/1% = 1; 8%/0.5% = 16 (S1, 99,5%); 8%/1% = 8 (S4, 99%). Situation values are introduced with "Suppose" in the lesson.

alerts.md L32-35: "Nhanh: tiêu 2% budget trong 1 giờ. Burn rate = 0,02 × 672 / 1 = 13,44. ... khoảng 50 giờ. Chậm: tiêu 5% budget trong 6 giờ. Burn rate = 0,05 × 672 / 6 = 5,6. ... budget hết trong 5 ngày." Checked: 672/13.44 = 50 h; 28/5.6 = 5 d. Round 2: s4 now derives 5.6 as 0.05 × 672 / 6, consistent.

alerts.md L38-39: "Ngưỡng của một SLI là burn rate × (1 − SLO), ví dụ S3 (SLO 99,5%): 13,44 × 0,5% ≈ 6,7%". Table L53-59: S1 and S3 "13,44 × 0,5% = 6,72%", S2 and S4 "13,44 × 1% = 13,44%". slo.rules.yml expr: `> (13.44 * 0.005)` for S1/S3, `> (13.44 * 0.01)` for S2/S4.
alerts.md L37-38: "Đây là lựa chọn của dự án, tính lại cho cửa sổ 28 ngày, không phải chuẩn chung."
alerts.md L41-43: "Mỗi mức xét hai cửa sổ cùng lúc. Cửa sổ dài (1 giờ, 6 giờ) ... cửa sổ ngắn (5 phút, 30 phút)". Lesson L98 only mentions the pair and defers the reason, matching depth_notes.

Arithmetic: 6 × 6 / 672 = 0.0536 → about 5.4%; one hour at 13.44 = 13.44/672 = 0.02 = 2%. 6 < 13.44 and 6 > 5.6. Holds under the uniform-traffic caveat of claim 10. Round 2: s5 L119 now states what each level catches, not why alerts.md chose it; supported by this arithmetic.

slo.md L81: error budget is "1 − SLO, tính theo số request" (example L82-83: 0,5% của 200.000 request = 1.000 request lỗi). Budget spent in an hour = bad share × requests in that hour, so b/672 equals the share of budget only if each hour carries 1/672 of the requests. Round 2 s4 wording (fixed number of bad requests) matches.
Arithmetic: 13.44 × 0.1% = 1.344% → "about 1.3%"; 30 × 24 = 720; 0.02 × 720 = 14.4. Lesson presents both as hypotheticals ("What would you choose if…").
Arithmetic: 0.3% / 0.5% = 0.6; at 0.6 the budget lasts 28/0.6 ≈ 46.7 days > 28, so budget remains at window end. Consistent with alerts.md L27-28 definition.

Stated with a condition in the lesson (Trade-offs row "Fits when"), not as unconditional advice. Supported by the repo's practice: alerts.md table L53-59 writes one burn rate per level and a per-SLI bad share. The "fits only when one SLI or equal SLOs" condition follows from claim 1.

slo.rules.yml records ratio_rate5m, 30m, 1h, 6h for each of product_reads_bad (L14-20), order_placement_bad (L47-53), order_placement_slow (L75-81), refund_requests_slow (L103-109). job:product_reads_bad:ratio_rate1h is S3 (GET api/v1/products.*), job:order_placement_slow:ratio_rate1h is S2 (le="0.512"). Four windows were also confirmed at the stage-4 tag in round 1.

Arithmetic from claim 1 and alerts.md table L53-59: 13.44% / 0.5% = 26.88 > 13.44, so a 13.44% threshold fires later than the project's fast level for S1/S3; 6.72% / 1% = 6.72 < 13.44, so a 6.72% threshold fires earlier for S2/S4. Lesson s8 wording matches and holds for any single fixed value.
